  function icon(name) {
    return `<svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">${iconPaths[name] || iconPaths.grid}</svg>`;
  }

  function img(file, alt, className = '') {
    return `<img class="${className}" src="${ASSETS[file] || ''}" alt="${alt}">`;
  }

  function topSearch() {
    return `<div class="search-row">
      <div class="brand-mark" aria-label="AI短剧">AI</div>
      <button type="button" class="search-box" data-action="toast" data-message="搜索功能为本地原型演示，暂无在线搜索结果">${icon('search')}<span>搜索短剧、剧情、关键词...</span></button>
      <button class="round-icon" data-nav="ranking" aria-label="排行榜">${icon('trophy')}</button>
      <button class="recharge" data-nav="coin-recharge">金币充值</button>
    </div>`;
  }

  function promo() {
    const config = window.ShortDramaAdminConfig?.homeBanner;
    if (!config?.enabled || !config.title) return '';
    return `<section class="promo" data-config-source="home-banner" ${config.targetRoute ? `data-nav="${config.targetRoute}" role="link" tabindex="0"` : ''}>
      <div class="promo-kicker">${config.kicker || ''}</div>
      <h2>${config.title}</h2>
      <div class="promo-meta"><strong>${config.highlight || ''}</strong><span>${config.subtitle || ''}</span></div>
    </section>`;
  }

  const navTargets = Object.freeze({
    '首页': 'home',
    '魔改短剧': 'ai-remix',
    '心愿榜单': 'wishlist',
    '专题': 'topics',
    '我的': 'profile',
  });

  function navItem(iconName, label, active) {
    return `<div class="nav-item ${active ? 'active' : ''}" data-nav="${navTargets[label]}" role="link" tabindex="0" ${active ? 'aria-current="page"' : ''}>${icon(iconName)}<span>${label}</span></div>`;
  }

  function tabbar(active) {
    return `<nav class="tabbar" aria-label="主要导航">
      ${navItem('home', '首页', active === '首页')}
      ${navItem('wand', '魔改短剧', active === '魔改短剧')}
      ${navItem('heart', '心愿榜单', active === '心愿榜单')}
      ${navItem('grid', '专题', active === '专题')}
      ${navItem('user', '我的', active === '我的')}
    </nav>`;
  }

  function posterCard({ file, title, badge, badgeType = '', heat, source, episodes, nav = '', dramaKey = '' }) {
    const accessibleTitle = title || '短剧海报';
    const selection = dramaKey ? ` data-before-state-key="selections.selected_drama" data-before-state-value="${dramaKey}"` : '';
    return `<article class="poster-card" ${nav ? `data-nav="${nav}"${selection} role="link" tabindex="0" aria-label="查看${accessibleTitle}详情"` : ''}>
      <div class="poster-frame">
        ${img(file, accessibleTitle)}
        ${badge ? `<span class="poster-badge ${badgeType}">${badge}</span>` : ''}
        ${heat ? `<span class="heat">${heat}</span>` : ''}
      </div>
      ${title ? `<h3>${title}</h3>` : ''}
      <div class="meta-row"><span>${source || ''}</span>${episodes ? `<span>·</span><span>${episodes}</span>` : ''}</div>
    </article>`;
  }

  function backButton(className = '') {
    return `<button class="back-btn ${className}" aria-label="返回">${icon('back')}</button>`;
  }

  function episodeGrid(total, { current = 1, paidFrom = 4, paidLabel = '金币', nav = '' } = {}) {
    return `<div class="episode-grid">${Array.from({ length: total }, (_, index) => {
      const number = index + 1;
      const currentClass = number === current ? 'current' : '';
      const locked = number >= paidFrom;
      const sub = number === current ? `${current}/${total}` : locked ? paidLabel : '';
      const target = locked ? (paidLabel === '会员' ? 'member-unlock' : 'coin-unlock') : nav;
      const attributes = nav
        ? `type="button" data-nav="${target}" data-before-state-key="selections.player_episode" data-before-state-value="${number}" aria-label="${locked ? `${paidLabel}解锁` : '播放'}第${number}集" aria-pressed="${number === current}"`
        : '';
      const tag = nav ? 'button' : 'div';
      return `<${tag} ${attributes} class="episode ${currentClass} ${locked ? 'locked' : ''}">${number}${sub ? `<small>${sub}</small>` : ''}</${tag}>`;
    }).join('')}</div>`;
  }

  function previewCard(avatar, user, copy) {
    return `<article class="preview-card">
      <div class="preview-user">${img(avatar, '', 'avatar')}<span>${user}</span></div>
      <p>${copy}</p>
      <div class="like-label">♡ 点赞</div>
    </article>`;
  }

  function actionbar() {
    return `<div class="actionbar">
      <button class="collect-btn">${icon('heart')}<span>收藏</span></button>
      <button class="primary-action">${icon('play')}<span>立即观看</span></button>
    </div>`;
  }

  window.ShortDramaComponents = Object.freeze({
    icon,
    img,
    topSearch,
    promo,
    tabbar,
    posterCard,
    backButton,
    episodeGrid,
    previewCard,
    actionbar,
  });
})();
